title: FIFA says that parts of 2026 World Cup matches will be broadcast live on TikTok and select creators will get access to press conferences and training sessions (Jessica Hopkins/The Athletic)
summary: Jessica Hopkins / The Athletic: FIFA says that parts of 2026 World Cup matches will be broadcast live on TikTok and select creators will get access to press conferences and training sessions — Video clips of World Cup games will be broadcast live on TikTok this summer, FIFA said on Thursday.
